alter table public.user_flag_overrides enable row level security;

create function public.is_public_and_overridable()
returns boolean
language sql
security definer
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.app_config ac
    where ac.key = (select key from public.user_flag_overrides where user_id = auth.uid())
      and ac.is_public = true
      and ac.user_overridable = true
  );
$$;

create policy "Anyone can read public config"
on public.app_config
for select
to anon, authenticated
using (is_public = true);

create policy "No one can modify app_config"
on public.app_config
for all
to anon, authenticated
using (false)
with check (false);

create policy "Users can read own overrides"
on public.user_flag_overrides
for select
to authenticated
using (user_id = auth.uid());

create policy "Users can insert own overrides for public overridable keys"
on public.user_flag_overrides
for insert
to authenticated
with check (
  user_id = auth.uid()
  and exists (
    select 1
    from public.app_config ac
    where ac.key = key
      and ac.is_public = true
      and ac.user_overridable = true
  )
);

on public.user_flag_overrides
for update

using (user_id = auth.uid());

create policy "Anonymous cannot access overrides"

for all
to anon

grant usage on schema public to anon, authenticated;
